test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A small mischievous fairy
solution: The correct answer is- 'elf.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's understand the meaning of elf: • **elf **is a noun and it means *a usually lively mischievous or malicious creature*. An imaginary being, often like a small person with pointed ears, in popular stories. (जीवंत शरारती या दुर्भावनापूर्ण प्राणी। एक काल्पनिक प्राणी, लोकप्रिय कहानियों में अक्सर नुकीले कानों वाले एक छोटे व्यक्ति की तरह।) • Example: *With his small frame and bright eyes, he'd always reminded her of an **elf **of some sort.* • By the above meaning and example, we can say that 'elf' is the correct answer. Hence *option 1 *is the appropriate answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's learn the meaning of the other given options: • **brownie - **Square or bar of very rich chocolate cake usually with nuts (आमतौर पर नट्स के साथ बहुत समृद्ध चॉकलेट केक का वर्ग या बार) • **dwarf - **a person who is markedly small (एक व्यक्ति जो काफी छोटा है) • **gnome - **a legendary creature resembling a tiny old man (एक पौराणिक प्राणी जो एक छोटे बूढ़े आदमी जैसा दिखता है) 97:Td81, The correct answer is- 'massive'
